descriptionNullable:
### Content

Horse2zebra dataset consists of 1187 Horse & 1474 Zebra Images. Images in both the domains are split into train and test subsets.

### Acknowledgements

This dataset was obtained from UC Berkeley's official directory of [CycleGAN Datasets](https://people.eecs.berkeley.edu/~taesung_park/CycleGAN/datasets/). For more details on the dataset refer the [related CycleGAN publication](https://arxiv.org/abs/1703.10593). Work based on the dataset should cite:

```
@inproceedings{CycleGAN2017,
  title={Unpaired Image-to-Image Translation using Cycle-Consistent Adversarial Networks},
  author={Zhu, Jun-Yan and Park, Taesung and Isola, Phillip and Efros, Alexei A},
  booktitle={Computer Vision (ICCV), 2017 IEEE International Conference on},
  year={2017}
}
```
subtitle: CycleGAN's Apples-to-Oranges Dataset
